summary: This bill requires the Secretary of Energy to prepare periodic assessments of the U.S. electricity generation and transmission supply chain—including risks, foreign dependencies, manufacturing barriers, and workforce issues—and submit reports on them to Congress starting within one year.

scores.thoughts: The bill requires the Department of Energy to conduct periodic assessments and reports, which would necessitate some level of government expenditure for personnel, research, and reporting activities. This represents a minor increase in government spending.
